outcome: Inspired and expired oxygen fractions differences
Right ventricle to left ventricle ratio
cohort: Fetal lambs, some with surgically induced congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH), delivered via cesarean section, were studied during resuscitation.
finding: CDH lambs exhibited significantly lower tidal volume, lower respiratory system compliance, higher airway resistance, pulmonary hypertension, pulmonary hypoplasia, and left ventricle hypoplasia compared to control lambs, successfully validating the lamb model as a reliable representation of human CDH.
